title: gte-small embeddings in Edge Functions are alive and free — but it's the only built-in model, and CPU time is the real ceiling
summary: new Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small') still generates 384-dim embeddings locally inside Edge Functions with no external API and no AI line item on any plan, including Free. Nothing in the docs, changelog or edge-runtime source deprecates it. The traps are that gte-small is the ONLY built-in model (any other name silently falls back to an external Ollama host you must provide via AI_INFERENCE_API_HOST), inputs truncate at 512 tokens and English only, and your real budget on Free is the 2 s CPU-time and 256 MB memory limits per request, not a pricing tier.

body.problem: You are deciding whether to build semantic search on Supabase's built-in embeddings or pay for an external embeddings API. You need to know whether Supabase.ai is a 2024 experiment that has since been pulled, and whether it works on a Free project. Models from before late 2026 tend to hedge toward "that was experimental, use OpenAI instead" or invent a plan gate that does not exist.
steps: In an Edge Function, create the session once at module scope (not per request) so the ONNX model loads once per worker: const model = new Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small').
Call it per request with pooling and normalization: await model.run(input, { mean_pool: true, normalize: true }) — output is a 384-dimension vector suitable for a pgvector vector(384) column.
Import 'jsr:@supabase/functions-js/edge-runtime.d.ts' if you want types for Supabase.ai.
Chunk input before embedding: anything past 512 tokens is truncated, and the model is English-only.
Size the Free plan by Edge Function limits, not by an AI quota: 500,000 invocations/month, 256 MB memory, 2 s CPU time per request, 150 s wall clock (400 s on paid).
If you need an LLM rather than embeddings, stand up your own Ollama or Llamafile server and set AI_INFERENCE_API_HOST — hosted LLM inference is still early-access via a signup form.

pitfalls.tried: Passing a different model name, e.g. new Supabase.ai.Session('bge-small') or ('mistral'), expecting the runtime to fetch it.
pitfalls.whyFailed: The runtime branches on the literal string 'gte-small' and initializes the local ONNX model only for that value. Any other name switches the session into external-inference mode, which is enabled only if the AI_INFERENCE_API_HOST env var is set — otherwise run() has no backend to talk to. gte-small remains the sole built-in model.

pitfalls.tried: Embedding a long document in one call and trusting the vector.
pitfalls.whyFailed: Input is truncated to 512 tokens, so the tail of the document silently contributes nothing; the docs warn truncation "may affect the accuracy". Embedding large batches in one request also runs into the 2 s CPU-time-per-request limit even though wall clock allows 150 s on Free.

pitfalls.tried: Looking for an "AI inference" or "embeddings" line on the pricing page to confirm Free-plan eligibility.
pitfalls.whyFailed: There is no such row — the Edge Functions pricing category contains only Invocations. Plan availability for Supabase.ai is simply not stated plan-by-plan in current docs; the explicit "available to all Edge Functions users, local, hosted and self-hosted" statement lives in the April 2024 launch blog.

pitfalls.tried: Constructing the Session inside the request handler.
pitfalls.whyFailed: Model init work gets repeated per invocation inside a 2 s CPU budget on a 256 MB worker; hoisting the session to module scope amortizes it across the requests a warm worker serves.

body.verification: Deploy a Free-project function that returns await new Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small').run('hello world', { mean_pool: true, normalize: true }) and confirm a 384-element float array comes back with no external network egress; then confirm the invocation shows up only under Edge Function Invocations usage, with no AI/inference usage item on the bill.
body.appliesWhen: Supabase hosted Edge Functions and supabase/edge-runtime main (v1.77.x, released 2026-10-01) as of 2026-10-17, local CLI, and self-hosted; model name exactly 'gte-small'; Free plan included.
body.notAppliesWhen: Does not cover non-English text or inputs over 512 tokens; does not provide any other embedding model; does not provide hosted LLM inference (Ollama/Llamafile mode requires your own server via AI_INFERENCE_API_HOST, hosted access is early-access only). Not a statement about embedding throughput: 256 MB memory and 2 s CPU per request bound batch size, and bulk backfills will hit the 500,000-invocation Free quota.
